title: Cell Normalization Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: A new tip is picked up.
The tip is dropped in the waste bin.

steps.title: Create Normalization CSV
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file named Normalization CSV with the exact headers: Source Plate, Source Well, Dest Plate, Dest Well, Buffer Volume (in µL), Culture Volume (in µL). Fill each row with the appropriate plate numbers (1‑4), well identifiers, and the desired buffer and culture volumes (e.g., 2,A1,1,A1,1591,1870).

steps.title: Load Pipettes and Labware
steps.instruction: Mount the P1000 single‑channel GEN2 pipette on the chosen mount (left or right). Select the labware type: Corning 24‑well plate or Corning 96‑well plate. If using 96‑well plates, prefill each well with the user‑specified Prefill Volume (µL) using a P300 8‑channel pipette before any transfers.

steps.title: Transfer Buffer to Destinations
steps.instruction: Using a single tip on the P1000, aspirate the buffer volume indicated in column E of the CSV and dispense it into the destination well indicated in column D. Perform all buffer transfers sequentially with the same tip.

steps.title: Discard Buffer Tip
steps.instruction: After completing all buffer transfers, drop the tip into the trash bin.

steps.title: Transfer Cultures per CSV
steps.instruction: For each row in the Normalization CSV, execute the following actions:

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip with the P1000.
Mix the source well (column B of source plate column A) three times.
Aspirate the culture volume specified in column F and dispense it into the destination well (column D of destination plate column C).
Discard the tip in the waste bin.

steps.title: Finish Protocol
steps.instruction: All transfers are complete; the protocol ends.
